Complete the problems here: HW_4.pdfand upload a pdf document of your work (note that we have restricted file types this time, but Canvas has a built in tool for pdfs if you need it). Please ensure that all problems are in a single document and that your work is legible. 


HW Guidelines:
All work should be shown. No credit given for problems that show answers only.  If you use software/code (e.g. Matlab, python, Wolfram Alpha), that should be included. As much as possible, solve in terms of variables first, and then plug in numbers. 

All work should be your own. Cite any help or collaboration with peers, TAs, AI. 

2 pts 1-4, 3 pts 5-8

Mostly graded on completion. -10% for incorrect answers (.1 per answer).

title: HW-Solution3
description:
Use it as the reference for grading your peer's homework assignments.

The total is 100 points for each HW assignments. If there are 5 assignments, each worth 20 pts.

For a problem worth 10 pts

Full credit (10 pts, 100%):

  • The process is correct
  • The reasoning is clear and logical
  • All necessary steps are shown
  • The final answer is correct with proper units (if applicable), 
  • All answers are properly circled (-1 pt if the answer is not circled)

Minor error (8-9 pts, 80-90%):

  • Minor algebra or arithmetic errors

  • Small notation mistakes

  • Missing units or minor formatting issues

  • Slightly unclear explanation, but the logic is still understandable

Partial credit (6-8 pts, 60-80%):

  • Important steps are missing or incorrect

  • The reasoning is incomplete or not clearly explained

  • The final answer is incorrect due to conceptual or procedural errors

Minimal credit (4–6 pts, 40-60%):

  • The approach is mostly incorrect

  • Key concepts are misunderstood

  • Very little correct reasoning is shown

No credit (0–4 pts, 0-40%):

  • No meaningful attempt

  • The answer is completely incorrect or irrelevant

  • The problem is left blank
